What we ship for DTC brands
The work your in-house lead keeps deferring: deeper flows, real segmentation, post-purchase journeys, and the operations glue between Shopify and the rest of the stack.
Email and SMS flows
Welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandon, post-purchase, win-back, replenishment. Built in Klaviyo or Attentive, A/B tested, attribution wired to GA4 and Triple Whale.
Segmentation that updates itself
RFM, predicted CLV, product affinity, churn risk. Segments rebuild nightly from Shopify and sync to Meta and Google for lookalikes and suppression.
UGC, reviews, and support
Pull reviews from Yotpo or Okendo into flows. Route Gorgias tickets by intent. Auto-request UGC after delivery and tag it back to the product.
Flows that don't read like a templated welcome series
Most stores run three flows and call it lifecycle. We map purchase behavior, build the missing branches, and tie every send back to revenue per recipient.
Segmentation, attribution, and clean reporting
A segment that doesn't update is a list. We rebuild yours from Shopify order data so the right people get the right send, and the report says where the revenue actually came from.
Predicted CLV and churn risk in Klaviyo
First-purchase signals, AOV, category, and recency rolled into segments your flows and ad audiences can actually use.
Attribution that survives iOS
Server-side events, UTM hygiene, and Triple Whale or Northbeam wired in so flow revenue isn't double-counted with paid.
Catalog, UGC, and support that scales with the SKU count
When you ship 50 new SKUs a quarter, the bottleneck is copy, tags, and tickets. We wire it together so launches stop blocking on the same three people.
Product copy and metadata, on-brand
Descriptions, alt text, SEO titles, and collection tags generated from your brief and your existing top performers, then pushed to Shopify with review.
UGC and review pipelines
Post-delivery review requests, UGC ingestion from Instagram and TikTok, and tagging back to product pages so social proof shows where it converts.
Support that drafts itself
Gorgias or Zendesk tickets routed by intent (WISMO, returns, sizing) with draft replies pulled from your help center. Agents approve and send.
Choosing your setup
Four ways ecommerce teams automate, compared
There is no single right answer: the honest comparison depends on order volume, how custom your operations are, and who maintains the system after launch.
